EC1: - Patient with symptoms of neuropathy during the screening.
EC2: - Patient whose Neurological severity score (NSS) score is ≥ 3.
EC3: - Patient whose neurological examination is abnormal [OR] and suggestive of neuropathy.
EC4: - Patient presenting a pathology that could cause neuropathy (e.g. diabetes, [OR] renal failure, etc.).
EC5: - Patient already participating in a category 1 research study (Jardé law).
EC6: - Patient in an exclusion period determined by another study.
EC7: - Patient under the protection of justice, [OR] under guardianship [OR] or under curatorship.
EC8: - Patient refusing to sign the consent form.
EC9: - Patient for which it is impossible to provide information about the study.
